title: pterozonium elaphoglossoides
intro: Pterozonium elaphoglossoides, commonly known as Pterozonium fern, is a type of fern found in tropical and subtropical regions. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, as well as its ability to support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Pterozonium elaphoglossoides include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
